cover.headline: Little Monsters,
cover.subhead: Spooky-cute plans near Spring Branch, Oct 30–Nov 1
cover.scene: Candid dusk photo on a leafy Houston neighborhood sidewalk: a diverse group of five kids ages 3 to 7 trick-or-treating together, laughing as they walk toward a porch glowing with jack-o'-lanterns. A Black girl in a pumpkin costume, a Latino boy dressed as a dinosaur, an East Asian girl as a witch with a little broom, a white toddler as a ghost holding a parent's hand, and a South Asian boy as an astronaut, all carrying candy buckets. Warm porch lights and string lights, deep blue evening sky above them, fallen leaves. Cozy and fun, not scary.

caption:
Calling all little monsters! 🎃 Here's where to trick-or-treat this Halloween weekend, close to home and around Houston.

Near Spring Branch: CityCentre's free store-to-store trick-or-treat Friday 5–8 pm, the Memorial Villages Police trunk-or-treat Friday from 6 pm, and your own street on Saturday night.

Around Houston: Scream on the Green (free), the last day of Zoo Boo, the Wings Over Houston Airshow and Día de los Muertos at the Children's Museum.

What's your little one going as this year? Tell us below!

Times can change, so check with each event before you go. More plans at the link in our bio. Follow @springbranchlittles for kid-friendly plans in Spring Branch & Memorial.
